# Gulf of Khambhat Tidal & Contamination Simulator — architecture / interface contract

Plain browser scripts (NO ES modules, NO build step, must work from `file://` and from `python -m http.server`).
Each file is an IIFE that attaches one global to `window`. Load order in index.html:
`data/gulf_data.js`, `js/model.js`, `js/colormaps.js`, `js/render.js`, `js/chart.js`, `js/livedata.js`, `js/app.js`.
Dark theme UI. No external libraries.

## Data: `window.GULF_DATA` (data/gulf_data.js, generated by tools/fetch_data.py)
```
{ source:{bathymetry,tides,wind,fetched},
  grid:{lon0:70.8, lat0:20.2, d:0.02, nx:111, ny:114, elev:[nx*ny ints, metres, +up, row-major, j=0 is SOUTH row]},
  time0:"2026-10-03T00:00Z", hours:744,
  boundary:[{lat,lon,eta:[hours]}...],            // open-sea forcing points
  stations:[{name,lat,lon,eta:[hours],cur:[km/h],dir:[deg]}...],   // Open-Meteo observations/model at gulf ports
  wind:{speed:[m/s], dir:[deg, meteorological FROM]} }
```

## Model: `window.GulfModel` (js/model.js — DONE, read it)
Key fields of an instance `m`:
- `nx, ny, N, lon0, lat0, d, dy, dxRow[j], dt, t` (seconds since `m.time0` = ms epoch), `tEnd`, `hours`
- `elev[N], h[N]` (still depth, +down), `mask[N]` (1 = model water), `isBnd[N]`, `cells/interior` Int32Array
- `eta[N]` sea level (m); total depth = eta+h; dry if `< GulfModel.HDRY`
- `u[N]` = east-face velocity between cell k and k+1 (m/s); `v[N]` = north-face velocity between k and k+nx
- `ru[N], rv[N], hasResidual` = tide-averaged (residual) face velocities
- `toxic[N], organic[N]` concentration (mg/L), `age[N]` water age (days)
- `particles` (struct of arrays: `count, x[], y[], kind[], age[], group[], id[], color[]`), kinds `GulfModel.KIND.{DRIFTER:0,PLUME:1,OIL:2}`
- `drifterTrails: Map(id -> {pts:[gx,gy,gx,gy...], group, born})`
- `industries:[{id,name,type,lon,lat,k,rate(kg/day),mode:'continuous'|'ebb'|'flood',on,mix:{toxic,organic,oil,color}}]`
- `stations:[{name,lat,lon,k,etaObs:Float32Array(hours),etaModel:Float32Array(hours, NaN until simulated)}]`
- `probeSeries: Float32Array(hours)` (NaN until simulated), `windAt(t)->[u,v]`, `sampleU/sampleV(gx,gy,U)`, `velCells(gx,gy,U,V)`
- methods: `step()`, `reset(t, keepTracers)`, `spinningUp`, `addIndustry`, `moveIndustry`, `removeIndustry`, `spill`, `addDrifters(gx,gy,count,spread)`, `seedDrifterGrid()`, `clearDrifters()`, `clearPollution()`, `setProbe(k)`, `summary()`, `setForcing(data)`, `nearestWet(lon,lat,minDepth)`

### Grid coordinates
"grid coords" (gx, gy): cell (i,j) centre is at gx=i, gy=j; gy increases NORTH. lon = lon0 + gx*d, lat = lat0 + gy*d.

## `window.Colormaps` (js/colormaps.js)
`Colormaps.get(name) -> (t in 0..1) => [r,g,b]` for names: `speed, diverging, contaminant, age, depth`.

## Renderer: `window.MapRenderer` (js/render.js)
```
const r = new MapRenderer(canvas, model);   // canvas fills its parent; handles devicePixelRatio
r.resize();                                 // call on window resize
r.layer = 'speed'|'eta'|'contaminant'|'toxic'|'organic'|'age'|'vorticity'|'none';
r.show = {particles:true, arrows:false, residualArrows:false, drifters:true, plume:true, labels:true, stations:true, industries:true};
r.flowSource = 'instant'|'residual';        // field driving animated flow streaks
r.draw(ui)   // every animation frame; ui = {selectedIndustryId, probe:{gx,gy}|null, hover:{gx,gy}|null, placing:{type}|null}
r.screenToGrid(sx, sy) -> [gx, gy];  r.gridToScreen(gx, gy) -> [sx, sy]   // sx,sy = CSS pixels relative to canvas
r.zoomAt(sx, sy, factor); r.panBy(dx, dy); r.fit();
r.hitIndustry(sx, sy) -> industry|null;  r.hitStation(sx, sy) -> station|null
r.legend() -> {title, stops:[css colors], min:'label', max:'label'}   // app draws legend from this
r.invalidateTrails()                         // clear streak canvas (after pan/zoom/jump)
```
Visual design: base map pre-rendered once from `model.elev` at ~4x grid resolution (bilinear): water coloured by depth (navy deep -> teal shallow), land shaded with hillshade in muted sand/olive tones, crisp coastline. Field overlay drawn as an nx*ny ImageData scaled with smoothing, only over wet cells, then land layer drawn on top so overlay doesn't bleed onto land (intertidal flats with 0<elev<1 drawn semi-transparent). Then: arrows, animated flow streaks (~3000 particles, faded trail canvas, like earth.nullschool; residual field boosted x8 so loops are visible), drifter trails (polylines coloured by group, head dot), plume particles (industry colour) and oil particles (black/brown), industries (🏭 emoji in a coloured circle with name), stations (small diamonds), city labels, probe marker, scale bar, north arrow, lat/lon graticule ticks. Cell aspect: screen y scale = x scale * (dy / dxRow[mid]).
City labels (lat,lon): Bhavnagar 21.76,72.15; Ghogha 21.68,72.28; Alang 21.40,72.18; Talaja 21.35,72.04; Mahuva 21.09,71.76; Pipavav 20.92,71.51; Diu 20.71,70.98; Dholera 22.25,72.19; Khambhat 22.31,72.62; Jambusar 22.05,72.80; Dahej 21.71,72.58; Bharuch 21.70,72.98; Hazira 21.12,72.65; Surat 21.17,72.83; Navsari 20.95,72.92; Valsad 20.61,72.93; Daman 20.41,72.83.
Overlay ranges: speed 0–2.5 m/s; eta −5..+5 m diverging; contaminant/toxic/organic log10 0.001–10 mg/L, transparent below 0.001; age 0–20 days; vorticity of residual (dv/dx − du/dy) ±2e-4 s⁻¹ diverging.

## Chart: `window.TideChart` (js/chart.js)
```
const c = new TideChart(canvas, model);
c.draw({stationIndex, tNow})   // top panel: station etaObs (Open-Meteo, grey) vs etaModel (cyan) over all hours;
                               // bottom panel (smaller): model.probeSeries (log-ish, orange) + wind speed (faint);
                               // vertical cursor at tNow; day ticks with dates (IST); spring/neap visible.
c.onSeek = (tSeconds) => {}    // set by app; fired on click / drag on chart
```

## Live data: `window.LiveData` (js/livedata.js)
`LiveData.fetchLatest(baseData) -> Promise<data>` — same shape as GULF_DATA (reuse `baseData.grid`, boundary/station lat-lon lists), fetching from
`https://marine-api.open-meteo.com/v1/marine?latitude=..&longitude=..&hourly=sea_level_height_msl,ocean_current_velocity,ocean_current_direction&past_days=30&forecast_days=1&timezone=GMT`
and wind from `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?...&hourly=wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m&wind_speed_unit=ms&past_days=30&forecast_days=1&timezone=GMT` (wind failure → keep zero wind, set `data.source.windError`). `LiveData.fetchWindOnly(data) -> Promise<bool>` fills data.wind in place.

## App: js/app.js + index.html + css/style.css (owned by main agent)
